tasks.spec:
You are an engineer. Your current working directory IS a git worktree of the freytag-forge repository (detached at HEAD). Edit files here directly. NEVER git commit, never touch any other checkout, never run `uv`, NEVER call a model (not `claude`, not `codex`), NEVER use the network, never run `python -m bench run`, never write factory/state/. FIRST run: [ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv . Environment for every command: `export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp`. Ruff (python files only): `.venv/bin/python -m ruff check <files>` / `.venv/bin/python -m ruff format <files>` (line length 120, Python 3.12). Never pass --cov to pytest. Run tests as `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 8 <files>`. Tests must be hermetic (no network, no real model). Shared code must stay story-agnostic (no story, scene or character names in production code; tests may use the repository's real story package and must also cover a synthetic package). ARCHITECTURE RULE (AGENTS.md, firm): world-model logic, meaning anything that reads or changes only world state, is a `World` method in packages/worldkeeper with its tests in packages/worldkeeper/tests; `storygame` only adapts and calls it. If an OLD test pins behaviour this change deliberately changes, update it and say so in NOTES.txt. Write NOTES.txt (worktree root, never committed) listing every ambiguity and your choice. Read first: AGENTS.md, docs/contributor-guide.md, docs/world-model-grounding.md. BACKGROUND. Scenes can now be entered without playing the preceding scenes (hosted `start_scene`, see storygame/runtime/entry_seed.py). Measured: `bare` entry (scene entry fact and placements only) leaves about 110 story facts unset and every earned item hidden at scene 3B; `thorough` entry (a persona that earns everything optional) is path-dependent and also not a state a real player has. The fix is a canonical, versioned entry state per scene: the world after a deterministic player earns only what the route requires. ALREADY BUILT in this tree (rounds 23a and 23b; read them first): worldkeeper `World.export_state`, `import_state`, `entry_problems`; storygame/runtime/entry_seed.py (`canonical` persona, `canonical_path_report`); storygame/runtime/entry_snapshots.py (golden `entry/<SCENE>.json` files for the default story, `load_entry_snapshot`, `state_from_snapshot`, `check_entry_snapshots`, `carry_in_report`, CLI); storygame/web_demo.py (gated `start_scene` with `start_state` `thorough` or `bare`). CONTRACT for this round: `start_state` accepts `canonical`, `thorough` and `bare`, and the DEFAULT becomes `canonical`: the hosted session loads the committed golden snapshot for `start_scene` through `load_entry_snapshot` and `state_from_snapshot` (no replay), then opens the scene as today. A stale or invalid snapshot (`EntrySnapshotError`) answers HTTP 422 with its plain message and creates no session. Everything else in the gate stays: 403 without the opted-in token or in production, 422 for an unknown scene or state. 

You may edit or create ONLY: storygame/runtime/entry_snapshots.py, storygame/story_package/default_root.py (new), storygame/web_demo.py, tests/test_entry_snapshots.py, tests/test_start_scene_session.py, docs/testing-runbook/hosted-e2e.md.

TASK. (1) LAYERING FIX. storygame/runtime/entry_snapshots.py imports `_default_package_root` from storygame/web_demo.py: the runtime must not depend on the HTTP layer, and web_demo is about to import entry_snapshots, which would be a cycle. Move the default-root resolution into the new storygame/story_package/default_root.py (`default_package_root() -> Path`, same result as today); make web_demo.py and entry_snapshots.py import it from there (keep the name `_default_package_root` working in web_demo.py as an alias so nothing else breaks). Prove with a test that importing `storygame.runtime.entry_snapshots` does not import `storygame.web_demo` (check `sys.modules` in a subprocess). (2) CARRY-IN REFINEMENT. The real story gives three carry-in gate rows (a storylet and its claim each) whose consumers are OPTIONAL storylets (not in `required_storylet_ids`) gated on facts produced by optional earlier storylets; a canonical player never earns those, so they are optional chains the canonical entry cannot reach, not entry-state defects. Change `carry_in_report` rows to add `consumer_required` (true when the consumer's storylet, or for a claim its source storylet, is in `required_storylet_ids`; use `storygame/story_package/obligations.py`). `check_entry_snapshots` reports a gate problem ONLY when `consumer_required` is true and `supplied` is false; optional-chain rows are returned by `carry_in_report` and printed by the CLI under a heading `optional chains not reachable from canonical entry` (informational, exit code unaffected). After this the CLI `check` must exit 0 on the real story. Update tests/test_entry_snapshots.py: the real-story check is now fully clean, the optional-chain rows are listed with `consumer_required` false, and a synthetic case with a REQUIRED gated consumer still produces a gate problem. (3) CANONICAL DEFAULT in web_demo.py per the contract above: map each package to its source root (where it was loaded from) so the right `entry/` directory is used; `start_state` accepts `canonical`, `thorough`, `bare`, default `canonical`. (4) Tests in tests/test_start_scene_session.py (update the earlier ones whose default changed, say so in NOTES.txt): default session at the SECOND scene id (read from the loaded package, never hardcode names) equals `state_from_snapshot` of that scene's snapshot (compare facts and world export) and a following turn works with the stub provider; `thorough` and `bare` still work; with the `entry/` file edited in a tmp copy of the story root (use `create_demo_app(package_roots=(tmp_root,))`) the session answers 422 and the store holds no session; the 403 and 422 gate cases still pass; a request without `start_scene` is unchanged. (5) docs/testing-runbook/hosted-e2e.md: update the existing paragraph (do not add a section): seeded entry defaults to the committed canonical snapshot; `thorough` and `bare` are labelled stress options. Run tests/test_entry_snapshots.py tests/test_start_scene_session.py tests/test_web_demo.py tests/test_canonical_entry_path.py tests/test_world_model.py packages/worldkeeper/tests and `ls tests/test_bench*.py`.
tasks.check:
set -eo pipefail
WORK=/home/bcorfman/dev/ringer-work/factory-23
mkdir -p "$WORK/out"
export PYTHONPATH=$PWD:$PWD/packages/worldkeeper/src TMPDIR=/tmp
[ -e .venv ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/.venv .venv
[ -e frontend/node_modules ] || ln -s /home/bcorfman/dev/freytag-forge/frontend/node_modules frontend/node_modules
git add -A -- storygame bench tests packages docs data frontend/e2e
bad=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep -vE '^(storygame/runtime/entry_snapshots\.py|storygame/story_package/default_root\.py|storygame/web_demo\.py|tests/test_entry_snapshots\.py|tests/test_start_scene_session\.py|docs/testing-runbook/hosted-e2e\.md)$' || true)
[ -z "$bad" ] || { echo "files outside ownership staged: $bad"; exit 1; }
start=$(date +%s)
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:cacheprovider -n 8 tests/test_entry_snapshots.py tests/test_start_scene_session.py tests/test_web_demo.py tests/test_canonical_entry_path.py tests/test_world_model.py packages/worldkeeper/tests $(ls tests/test_bench*.py)
.venv/bin/python -m storygame.runtime.entry_snapshots check
.venv/bin/python -c "import sys; import storygame.runtime.entry_snapshots; sys.exit(1 if 'storygame.web_demo' in sys.modules else 0)" || { echo 'entry_snapshots imports web_demo'; exit 1; }
grep -q 'consumer_required' storygame/runtime/entry_snapshots.py || { echo 'consumer_required missing'; exit 1; }
grep -q 'canonical' storygame/web_demo.py || { echo 'canonical default missing in web_demo'; exit 1; }
took=$(( $(date +%s) - start ))
echo "checks took $took s (budget 420 s)"
[ "$took" -le 420 ] || { echo "over the 420 s budget"; exit 1; }
PYFILES=$(git diff --cached --name-only | grep '\.py$' || true)
[ -z "$PYFILES" ] || .venv/bin/python -m ruff check $PYFILES
[ -z "$PYFILES" ] || .venv/bin/python -m ruff format --check $PYFILES
git diff --cached > "$WORK/out/backend-canonical-default.patch"
test -s "$WORK/out/backend-canonical-default.patch"
tasks.verified: Canonical snapshot entry is the hosted default; stale snapshots are refused; the runtime no longer imports the HTTP layer; the real story's entry check is clean.
